name: ai-skills
description: Skills for Claude Code: new-app scaffolds a new multi-platform product on our standard stack; check-updates audits outdated packages, SDKs, CI tasks, images, machine tools and VS Code extensions; security-scan finds vulnerable dependencies and images, leaked secrets, insecure IaC and CI, and vulnerable code. check-news gathers recent news, releases, advisories and deprecations for the technologies a repo uses.
